name: Enzyme Gel Cleanser
descriptor: A fresh start. A smooth finish.
description: A gel facial cleanser with papaya fruit extract and salicylic acid. Massage onto damp skin and rinse well, morning or evening.
ingredients: Papaya fruit extract, Salicylic acid, Glycerin
directions: Apply a small amount to pre-moistened skin and gently massage. Rinse well with water. May be used twice daily.

name: Hyaluronic Serum
description: A lightweight aloe-based serum with glycerin, panthenol and sodium hyaluronate, for skin that feels dehydrated. Apply after cleansing, before moisturizer.
directions: After cleansing and toning, apply to entire face and neck. Once absorbed, follow with moisturizer and/or sun protection products (SPF). May be used twice daily.
inci: Water, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf, Propylene Glycol, Glycerin, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Phenoxyethanol, Panax Ginseng Root Extract, Allantoin, Panthenol, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Symphytum Officinale Leaf Extract, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Equisetum Hiemale Extract, Methylisothiazolinone, Sodium Hyaluronate, Yellow 5, Blue 1

name: Peptide Anti-Wrinkle Day Cream
description: A rich morning cream with aloe, sodium hyaluronate, panthenol and squalane, for dull, dry-feeling skin. Follow with sun protection.
ingredients: Aloe leaf, Sodium hyaluronate & glycerin, Squalane
directions: Warm a small amount between your fingertips and massage into face, neck and décolleté. Follow with sun protection (SPF) in the morning.
